newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures close lower on thin market.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures close lower on thin market.

text.p: UK feed wheat futures continued to drift lower on Monday on a thin market.
"We've been saying for some time that there are not many sellers about, but now the buyers seem to be disappearing," said a trader.
Wheat futures tried to rally early in the afternoon session, but this fizzled out and by the close values were unchanged to 0.15 stg down on a turnover of 802 lots.
Barley closed higher at 0.25 to 0.50 stg, but turnover was only 40 lots.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures contract closed five marks down after trading five lots all in February 1997 at 275 marks.
UK cash trade was slow with no business reported on the fob market while delivered trade was mainly for material for delivery up to the end of the year.
